description: Measures the step-4 auto-checkpoint -> /clear -> resume hand-off (bin/flow-checkpoint.ts + bin/flow-session-start-hook.ts) across a plan-approval addendum resume, a plain plan-approval resume, a gated-feedback resume, and a post-merge terminal-orientation turn. s1 and s4 are the candidate-covering scenarios: they seed state.phase checkpoint-pending-clear, the step-4 auto-checkpoint site under evaluation. s2 (gated site) and s3 (terminal site) are controls that survive any removal of the candidate.
